input: The peak (dBFS) the player measured at each output since its last state, with the lane labels (A1, A2), a rectangle and theme colours.
output: Bars on a dBFS scale (-48 to 0; green, yellow from -12, red from -3) with a short peak hold. It measures, plays and reads nothing; only the fall of a bar between two states is its own.
specification: User 2026-10-16: a level meter on the Segments panel in place of the middle buttons, from the player's real output, two horizontal bars A1/A2.
